questions.text: What can a person do with a document?
questions.assumed: View or edit; being able to edit includes being able to view.

questions.text: Who can share or unshare a document?

questions.assumed: No: teams contain people only; nested teams come later.

questions.text: Do folders nest, and does sharing a folder share everything inside it?
questions.assumed: Yes to both: folders form a tree, a document is in at most one folder, and a share of a folder covers everything inside it, at any depth.

questions.text: What is out of scope for the first version?
questions.assumed: Consistency snapshots (versions), deny rules, expiring shares, audit logs and outside identity providers.
